rationale: Hapax-like form on this page paired with ⲡⲗⲏⲅⲏ 'blows.' May relate to ⲥⲛⲁϩ 'bond' or to a doublet-formation for sufferings. Tentative.
Directional/spatial term in 'hanging at a distance against them.' Possibly from ⲟⲩⲉ 'be far' or ⲡⲁⲍⲟⲩ 'rear, behind.' Confidence low; flagged for parallels.
Verb in line 33 ⲁⲩⲍⲁϣⲟⲩ ⲁⲍⲟⲩⲛ 'they hastened/rushed inward.' Possibly Lyc. reflex of ϫⲱϣ or ϩⲱϣ. Tentative.
Lyc. reflex of ϩⲱⲧⲡ̄ 'be joined, set, agree.' Substantival 'their joining (themselves) with the right hand of Peace.' Distinct from Greek ζώνη.
Future relative 'that would befall them.' Lyc. reflex of ⲧⲱϩ 'reach' or ⲧⲁϩⲟ 'set upon.' Used here of evils that come upon the Five Sons through the Darkness.
